title: An Investigational Drug Study in Healthy Adult Volunteers in a Model of Insomnia (0928-007)
brief_summary: A study to evaluate the safety and effectiveness of an investigational drug for insomnia (a sleep disorder).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Healthy adults who are between the ages of 18 and 64

Exclusion Criteria:

* Adults who are diagnosed with insomnia
